verified_findings.finding: Python payload embedded in the text file parses successfully as Python syntax.
The files.sha256 field is computed from the indexed byte prefix after max_bytes truncation, not necessarily the complete file.
verified_findings.repair: Store full_file_sha256 separately or rename the current field to indexed_prefix_sha256.

verified_findings.finding: Incremental unchanged detection uses size+mtime only and can miss content changes that preserve both.
verified_findings.repair: Use a stronger content identity policy for admission/replay-critical sources.

verified_findings.finding: A scan does not remove database records for files deleted from the source tree.
verified_findings.repair: Add source-snapshot generation and explicit stale-row pruning/retention semantics.

verified_findings.finding: walk_files does not explicitly reject symlinks or track visited inode identities; scope escape/loops are possible depending on filesystem layout.
verified_findings.repair: Reject symlink traversal by default and bind scans to a declared root/source identity.

verified_findings.finding: chunk_text has no guard requiring 0 <= overlap < max_chars; invalid values can prevent forward progress.
Bulk scan temporarily sets SQLite synchronous=OFF, weakening durability during ingestion.
verified_findings.repair: Make durability mode explicit and do not describe an OFF scan as crash-proof.

verified_findings.finding: Results are ordered by native FTS5 bm25 rank, but the exported score uses abs(rank), obscuring native ordering semantics.
verified_findings.repair: Expose native_bm25_rank and an explicitly defined display score separately.

verified_findings.finding: The captured concatenated syslog contains 39 syslog start markers and 38 kernel-version boot markers.
The capture contains 540 PCP MAP records, consistently targeting one redacted LAN endpoint and one service port over TCP/UDP.
verified_findings.privacy: LAN address, WAN address, gateway and PCP tokens omitted from public projection.

verified_findings.finding: Boot sequences begin with a repeated default-looking May timestamp and later jump after NTP to December timestamps.
The capture contains 51 kernel net_ratelimit notices indicating suppressed callbacks.
Inter-arrival jitter and event timing are ordinary network/system stochastic observations in this evidence.
A valid JSON object ends after 334 bytes, followed by 329436 ASCII zero characters and line breaks; the complete file is not valid single-document JSON.
The prefix contains a 64-hex signature field, salt, value=322 and lore naming mnemosyne_cache.json, but origin_hash is null and no verification algorithm/key is supplied.
A CREDIT value is an application/resource artifact only.
QuantumObserver.__init__ calls timedelta(...) although the module imports datetime but not timedelta.
Observation counters/timestamps mutate before awaiting memory.remember; a persistence failure can leave local state advanced without a durable receipt.
register_observation creates an unretained asyncio task; delivery/persistence completion is not acknowledged to the caller.
Wave-function collapse/superposition language is narrative metaphor in this module, not evidence of quantum measurement or quantum randomness.
sin_entropy_level is an internal symbolic variable driven by timers and pulses, not an observed measure of humanity/world entropy.
last_resurrection is set before memory.remember; if durable memory fails, cooldown state can advance without a persisted redemption receipt.
register_disappointment_pulse accepts unvalidated intensity; negative or non-finite inputs are not explicitly rejected.
verified_findings.repair: Require finite non-negative bounded pulse values.
